maria-cs: Morning checkpoint for RavenPort private/VPC onboarding — need quick confirm on 4 items: route propagation, NAT egress, KMS cross-account, CloudTrail delivery. Any immediate flags?
jess-eng: Route propagation for rtb-77 shows pending; `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --route-table-ids rtb-77` shows 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-04 and missing 10.20.8.0/24 -> tgw-0abcd. I'll attach output if helpful.
oliver-se: I can push the static route to TGW attachment now. FYI customer requires source-NAT for egress to their logging endpoint (we're fine behind NAT GW).
raj-infra: pushed route 10.20.8.0/24 -> tgw-0abcd at 12:42Z; propagation state moved to "available". Confirmed traffic flow with `tcpdump` on proxy — SYNs reach collector but response 403 from collector.
ops-bot: cloudtrail_event: Trail "ravenport-org-trail" created 2026-02-20T12:30Z
jess-eng: 403 on collector likely IP whitelist. Our collector IP is 34.66.77.88 — ask customer to add to allowlist. On KMS: key policy currently denies external principals. We'll need explicit statement for their ops role `arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/rv-ops`. Sample snippet provided in runbook.
maria-cs: I'll tag customer PM to approve KMS policy. Risk: if KMS approval slips past Thu, renewal cadence impacted. Add to risk tracker.
oliver-se: Added risk "KMS cross-account approval delay" with mitigation: short-lived ingest key we manage (audit-only). Customer acceptance required.
raj-infra: CloudTrail delivery showed initial PutObject 403 due to missing `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` principal in bucket policy — added explicit allow, re-delivery succeeded.
maria-cs: Great — summary: routes OK, NAT OK, KMS policy pending customer sign-off, CloudTrail ingest working. Actions: raj confirm collector reachability after allowlist; jess paste KMS snippet into runbook and DM PM; maria schedule follow-up Thu 09:30 UTC. Thanks :rocket:
